policy: Expected text fixes only spelling, grammar (a word put into the form the sentence needs, such as a verb ending or a German case ending), punctuation, capitalisation and spacing. Where the language accepts more than one form, the other one is listed under alternatives and scores as a match. It never adds a terminal full stop that the input does not have, because a chat message written without one is not wrong, and adding one is the over-correction this app exists to avoid. Protected spans (URLs, emails, @handles, #channels, backticked code, emoji, deliberately lower-case product names) are always identical in input and expected. A case whose expected text equals its input is a negative and must come back byte-identical.
